messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday (or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend), giving you at least three consecutive days off.

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if different) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|--------------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | Sat Jan 1 – Mon Jan 2 |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Mar 31 | — | Fri Mar 31 – Sun Apr 2 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | — | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | — | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | — | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Friday Nov 11 | — | Fri Nov 11 – Sun Nov 13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | — | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |

### Notes & Variations

| Province | Extra long‑weekend holidays in 2023 |
|----------|-------------------------------------|
| **Alberta** | Family Day – Friday Feb 20 |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day – Friday Feb 20 |
| **Manitoba** | St. Patrick’s Day – Friday Mar 17 |
| **Ontario** | Family Day – Friday Feb 20; St. Patrick’s Day – Friday Mar 17 |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day – Friday Feb 20 |
| **New Brunswick** | Family Day – Friday Feb 20 |
| **Nova Scotia** | Family Day – Friday Feb 20 |
| **Prince Edward Island** | Family Day – Friday Feb 20 |
| **Quebec** | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day – Saturday Jun 24 (observed Monday Jun 26) |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Patrick’s Day – Friday Mar 17; Family Day – Friday Feb 20 |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • If you want a *complete* list, include the provincial holidays above.  
> • For a *national* view, the table above covers all statutory holidays that create a long weekend across Canada in 2023.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full provincial breakdown or any other details!
